verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Thundering Smash and let him stack Frenzied Maul for free; you win by kiting autos and poking him down before he ever gets in range.

brief.thesis: Volibear has no ranged poke and only one engage tool, so Teemo's 680-range Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot autos win every exchange he doesn't get to start on his terms. The data confirms it: 56.1% win rate over 1475 games with both lane and solo-kill advantage favoring Teemo, even though the matchup is 'even' in raw kill potential once he closes the gap.

theirWindow.when: Q (Thundering Smash) is up and he's near you
theirWindow.what: He will try to gain speed toward you and Attack-stun the first target hit, with cooldown 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s. If he starts the dash animation, blind him with Q (Blinding Dart) before it lands — this is OP.GG's own tip and it works because the stun is tied to the Attack landing, which Blinding Dart prevents.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Thundering Smash) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and poke freely with autos (E, Toxic Shot) and Blinding Dart. He has zero ranged retaliation outside W (Frenzied Maul) at 325 range and Q at 300 range, so anything past that is a free hit for you.

start.why: 57.9% win rate over 1395 games and the dominant pick (74.6%) — the extra sustain and mana regen let you spam Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot in every poke window without running dry.

boots.why: 57.9% win rate over 973 games (53.7% pick) — the flat movement speed keeps you out of Thundering Smash's 300 range and Frenzied Maul's 325 range, where Volibear does all his damage.

core.why: First item in the top build path (60.9% win rate over 519 games) — the on-hit proc and move speed let you poke and kite in the same action.
Pairs with Shiv for a 60.9% win rate over 519 games — the burn damage punishes Volibear every time he commits to an engage, since he has to stand near you to use W (Frenzied Maul).
Closes out the top build path at 60.9% over 519 games — the cooldown reduction stacks more Blinding Darts into his engage windows.

runes.keystoneWhy: 58.2% win rate on the Sorcery secondary page and 55% on the Resolve page — the vulnerable debuff amplifies your poke damage every time you land three autos before he closes distance.

summoners.why: 92.4% pick rate at 56.9% win rate — Ignite punishes his lack of sustain early and seals kills once Blinding Dart lands, since he has no ranged way to disengage.

playing.title: Blind the Q animation, not the hit
playing.detail: Fire Q (Blinding Dart) the instant you see him start Thundering Smash. Blind prevents the Attack from landing, which means the stun never triggers — this is the single highest-value play in the matchup.

playing.title: Trade only when his Q is down
playing.detail: Track his Thundering Smash cooldown (12s at rank 1, down to 10s at max rank). Outside that window he has no way to close distance on you, so every auto you land is free.

playing.title: Never let him double-tap W
playing.detail: W (Frenzied Maul) deals bonus damage and heals him if he lands it twice on the same mark. If he hits you once, back off immediately rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Use Move Quick to reset spacing
playing.detail: W (Move Quick) builds passive speed until he strikes you — pop it to walk up, poke, and walk back out before his Attack lands and cancels the buff.

playing.title: Camouflage for vision control, not damage
playing.detail: Standing still to go Invisible is strong for juking his Q engage or scouting river bushes, but don't rely on it mid-fight — breaking it gives you attack speed, which you should time right before your next trade.

playing.title: Respect his shield on E
playing.detail: Sky Splitter slows and damages in an area and shields him if he's standing in the blast. Don't walk into it expecting free damage — bait it from max range instead.

playing.title: Play around his ultimate near towers
playing.detail: Stormbringer disables nearby towers temporarily on landing. From level 6 onward (full value 11+), don't overextend under your tower expecting turret backup if he's near ult range at 550.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and win rates are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reads on cooldowns, blind timing, and engage windows are my own tactical analysis layered on top.
